mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, original_topic, mode, candidate_count, status, topic_frame_json, final_response_json, error_message, created_at, completed_at FROM ai_round_candidate_runs WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_round_candidate_runs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', topic_frame_json = #{topicFrameJson}, final_response_json = #{finalResponseJson}, error_message = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_round_candidate_runs SET status = 'FAILED', topic_frame_json = #{topicFrameJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
